matcher.of.says: Setting up the 'same record' matcher for one run: reading the records it compares and running its rules over them.

matcher.of.read.says: Reading the records to be compared.

matcher.of.podcodes.says: Looking up the medical codes of the records being compared.

matcher.of.withcurrentversions.says: Adding each record's current version to the comparison.

matcher.of.over.says: Running the matching rules over the records.

matcher.of.withpartners.says: Adding the records that matched, so their partners are compared too.

matcher.of.releaseview.says: Letting go of the matcher's working copy of the facts.

matcher.recordreads.says: Reading the records the matcher compares.

matcher.actstaken.says: Working out which acts (an import, an entry session, a connect or a sync) this run takes records from.

matcher.take.says: Judging which records this import, entry, connect or sync brought are the same as records the pod holds, and recording each match.

matcher.filefindings.says: Writing a finding for review for each pair of records one of the finding rules gives.

matcher.view.says: Building the matcher's working copy of the facts.
